# Rich-text assets

Loaded on demand from the same origin so Markdown and math work without a CDN.

- marked 15.0.12: https://registry.npmjs.org/marked/-/marked-15.0.12.tgz
- DOMPurify 3.3.1: https://registry.npmjs.org/dompurify/-/dompurify-3.3.1.tgz
- KaTeX 0.16.22, including fonts: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz

Upstream license files are included beside each library. Mermaid remains a separately loaded optional diagram component.
